data.one_liner: A BASF‑styled Flutter component library offering themes, widgets, and animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides ready‑made UI elements such as buttons, dialogs, text fields, and snackbars styled to BASF guidelines. Includes theming support, custom fonts, icons, and simple animation helpers.
use_when: You need a consistent corporate UI without building widgets from scratch
You want ready‑made themed components and custom fonts
You need built‑in Rive animations and scanner integrations
avoid_when: You require a highly customizable design system beyond the provided BASF style
You need code‑generated models or JSON serialization
You target web‑only projects without native scanner support
weaknesses: Tied to BASF branding, less flexible for other designs
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, include the provided fonts in pubspec.yaml, and optionally configure BasfThemes.lightMainTheme with fontFamilyFallback. No build_runner needed.
